newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes slightly higher as Dow drops.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes slightly higher as Dow drops.

text.p: Scattered strength in high techs helped Nasdaq stocks struggle to a higher close Tuesday as the Dow Industrials closed lower.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 3.86 points, or 0.32 percent, at 1215.33 at the close. Advances inched ahead of declines 2,071 to 2,058 on volume of about 589 million shares.

But the techs were a mixed bag at best, with Dell Computer following through on Monday's weakness and falling 4-13/16 to 80-1/8 after Bear Stearns was reported to have cut its rating to attractive from buy.

IMP shares fell two to 4-1/2. The company warned after the market close Monday that it expected a significant loss in the second quarter ended September due to weaker demand and restructuring charges.
But semiconductors were steady after Hambrecht & Quist said semiconductor-related companies were experiencing a significant change in PC OEM buying patterns as orders were getting noticably stronger.
Applied Materials was up 1-3/4 at 27-3/4 while Intel was up 3/4 at 96-1/2.
